app_documentation:
The Real-Time Inventory Management System is a comprehensive mobile-first application designed to streamline inventory tracking and sales operations for retail stores. Built with React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, the system enables store personnel to manage product catalogs, track stock levels in real-time, and receive automated alerts when inventory falls below defined thresholds. The application features barcode scanning capabilities for quick product lookups and inventory updates, ensuring accurate stock management with minimal manual data entry.

The system serves three primary user roles: Store Owners who oversee business performance through sales analytics and reporting, Store Managers who handle product management and inventory oversight, and Store Clerks who perform day-to-day operations like scanning products and updating stock levels. Key features include real-time inventory synchronization across multiple users via WebSocket connections, automated low stock alerts with configurable thresholds, comprehensive product management with categories and pricing, and detailed sales reporting with trend analysis and top-selling product insights.

The application's mobile-optimized interface prioritizes quick access to essential functions through a bottom navigation bar, featuring dedicated screens for Dashboard overview, Barcode Scanning, Inventory browsing, Alerts management, and User Profile. The design emphasizes efficiency with color-coded stock level indicators, swipe actions for quick alert resolution, and pull-to-refresh functionality for data synchronization. Real-time updates ensure all users see synchronized inventory data within 3 seconds of any transaction or adjustment.

Built with accessibility and performance in mind, the system maintains WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with proper contrast ratios, touch target sizing, and screen reader support. The PostgreSQL database schema supports comprehensive audit trails through inventory adjustment tracking, transaction history, and alert logging, enabling store owners to maintain full visibility into stock movements and business operations.

glossary.Barcode Scanning: The process of using a mobile device camera or dedicated scanner to read product barcodes (UPC/EAN codes) for instant product identification and inventory lookup, enabling quick stock updates without manual data entry.
glossary.Real-Time Synchronization: The automatic propagation of inventory changes across all connected users within 3 seconds using WebSocket technology, ensuring all store personnel see current stock levels immediately after transactions or adjustments.
glossary.Low Stock Alert: An automated notification triggered when a product's inventory quantity falls below its configured minimum threshold, displayed with color-coded severity levels (red for critical, orange for warning) to prompt timely restocking.
glossary.Inventory Adjustment: A manual modification to product stock levels recorded in the audit trail with details including adjustment type (addition, removal, correction), quantity change, responsible user, and reason for the change.
glossary.Transaction: A completed sales record that automatically decreases inventory quantities for sold products, containing line items with product references, quantities, unit prices, payment method, and total amount for reporting and analytics.
glossary.Stock Threshold: The minimum inventory quantity level configured per product that triggers low stock alerts when reached, typically set to 10 units by default but customizable based on product demand and restocking lead times.
